chunks.heading: Talir's Stolen Documents
chunks.text:
At the end of [[Session 38]], [[Talir Rengavi]] sent [[Riffle]] a furious Sending message. He demanded that Riffle return documents stolen from his safe that afternoon, saying Archivist [[Siobhan]] saw Riffle enter his office.

Riffle did visit Talir that day, before helping [[Karyn]] tidy her office. The notes don't say whether Riffle was ever in Talir's office alone or went near the safe. This is the second time a witness has placed someone resembling Riffle at a theft. Compare the framing in the [[Daggins Murder]].

chunks.heading: Open questions
chunks.text:
- What documents were taken?
- Who did Siobhan see, and can she be trusted?
- Is this the same person or group who framed Riffle for Daggins's murder?

**Status:** unresolved.

chunks.heading: Owens Family Deaths
chunks.text: Lord Richard Owens, a wealthy [[Amberhold]] merchant, and his wife recently died. Sailors at the [[Cock and Pig]] are stuck in port because his ship can't be unloaded into his warehouse ([[Session 36]]).

chunks.heading: What the party has heard ([[Session 38]])
chunks.text:
- Rumours say the cook poisoned them.
- Their son [[Peter Owens]] has taken leave from [[Mistra's Academy]] and is visiting the [[Owens Family Mausoleum]] unusually often.
- Students find Peter strange and unsettling.
- A cloaked, hooded figure entered the mausoleum and vanished as the party arrived.

**Status:** unresolved.

chunks.heading: Recent developments
chunks.text:
- [[Session 39]]: [[Richard Owens|Lord Richard]] and [[Gezibel Owens|Lady Gezibel Owens]]'s coffins in the hidden crypt were **empty**. [[Peter Owens]] had raised them as **greater zombies**, and the party destroyed them in his laboratory.
- [[Session 39]]: Still unknown: how they died, and whether Peter killed them or only raised them afterwards. The cook rumour ([[Session 38]]) is neither confirmed nor ruled out.
- [inference] In [[Session 25]], [[Lord Ivan Deepshaft]] said a greater zombie can only be made from someone who was "greater" in life, not a commoner. Wealthy nobles would qualify.

chunks.heading: Miner's Death Lode
chunks.text:
A legendary / highly dangerous mithril mine containing naturally occurring poisonous gas. Even Dwarves' natural poison resistance is insufficient.

Historical records indicate the [[Cult of the Destroyer]] attempted to mine it but abandoned the project because too many enslaved workers died.

The party later encountered necromantic activity and stolen bodies connected to a mine with similar poison characteristics.

chunks.heading: Lords of the Elements
chunks.text:
About 3,000 years ago, elemental forces were wreaking havoc across [[Ligos]]. The [[Elementalist Syndicate]] tried to control them by binding multiple elementals into larger entities.

The resulting beings became too powerful and escaped.

chunks.heading: Known Lords
chunks.text:
- **Lord of Earth** — body became the foundation of [[Derragh]], a Dwarven settlement in the far north.
- **Lord of Air** — believed alive and possibly residing in the upper atmosphere.
- **Lord of Water** — took to the sea; supposedly killed by an ancient dragon turtle, but unconfirmed.
- **Lord of Fire** — defeated in the western volcanic region. Mages froze it into obsidian and shattered it. The [[Mystery Stone]] is one fragment.

chunks.heading: Heaven's Touch Enchantment
chunks.text:
In [[Session 38]], [[Theo'din Corvis]] noticed an aura or enchantment settled on people inside [[Heaven's Touch]]. [[Zelda]], who left the [[Velvet Glove Brothel]] for Heaven's Touch a few weeks earlier, also appeared enchanted.

The brothel is a no-magic-casting area. Theo was escorted out for trying to Dispel Magic on Zelda, and the party had to leave with him.

chunks.heading: Related
chunks.text:
- Heaven's Touch is known for uncannily matching clients to their preferences ([[Session 35]]).
- It is drawing business away from the Velvet Glove.

**Status:** unresolved.

chunks.heading: Blond Skeletal Hand Recruiter
chunks.text: A blond young man who appears to recruit for the [[Skeletal Hand]] in [[Amberhold]].

chunks.heading: Evidence
chunks.text:
- [[Session 30]]: A cultist questioned with Speak with Dead after [[Christolf Nightfall]] was killed said he couldn't afford the Academy, and was offered "a different path" by a blond-haired youth **named Peter**, at an inn in Amberhold.
- [[Cam Jergins]] copied his Skeletal Hand tattoo from a small, blond young "kid" ([[Session 36]]).
- [[Session 37]]: A job-board flyer appears as a request for help moving boxes to Academy-associated people, but as a private scholarship offer to everyone else. It says to go to a particular tavern, order a beer, an ale and a wine at once, and wait. A blond you

chunks.heading: Evidence
chunks.text:
, an ale and a wine at once, and wait. A blond young man approached the party, said those not admitted to the Academy would be hired for quests, and left. [[Furgus]] saw a Skeletal Hand tattoo under his sleeve. The party believes he used Disguise Self on leaving, and a black-haired woman they didn't recognise followed him out.
- [[Session 38]]: [[Sabrina]] described a young blond man calling himself [[Andrew]] who saw a Velvet Glove worker named Angela. The party wonders if he's the same person.

chunks.heading: Open questions
chunks.text:
- The recruiter gave the name **Peter** ([[Session 30]]). [[Peter Owens]] is a strange Academy graduate student. The notes don't connect the two, so whether they're the same person is unestablished.
- Is "Andrew" ([[Session 38]]) an alias of the same person?
- [[Session 25]]: The black feathers left at the [[Daggins Murder]] were bought by an androgynous human with long blonde hair. Unclear if related.

chunks.heading: Party plans
chunks.text:
- [[Riffle]] is considering ordering the drinks again after several days to see whether they are approached.

**Status:** unresolved.

chunks.heading: Recent developments
chunks.text: - [[Session 39]]: [[Peter Owens]] has been captured. The notes still don't describe his hair or mention a Skeletal Hand tattoo, so whether he's the recruiter "Peter" remains open. He did make greater zombies, as [[Christolf Nightfall]] did with [[Nastil]].

chunks.heading: Icemoor Campaign Vault
chunks.text: A structured Obsidian vault generated from the campaign notes in **Icemoor Mountains copy.docx**.

chunks.heading: How this vault is organized
chunks.text:
- [[Campaign Dashboard]] — central navigation and active mysteries
- [[Timeline]] — session chronology and major events
- `Sessions/` — one note per recorded session
- `People/` — PCs and NPCs
- `Places/` — settlements, regions, dungeons, shops, and landmarks
- `Factions/` — organizations, clans, cults, and political groups
- `Quests/` — active, completed, and unresolved hooks
- `Items/` — important objects and magic items
- `Lore/` — gods, history, mysteries, monsters, and setting facts
- `Clues & Mysteries/` — investigation threads and unresolved questions
- `Resources/` — extracted referenc

chunks.heading: How this vault is organized
chunks.text:
lved questions
- `Resources/` — extracted reference material and campaign indexes

chunks.heading: Conventions
chunks.text:
- `[[Wiki Links]]` are intentionally dense to improve graph visualization.
- YAML frontmatter supports Obsidian search and Dataview-style workflows.
- `status: unresolved` is used for plot threads that remain open in the notes.
- Information is preserved as **campaign notes**, not treated as externally verified canon.
- Contradictory spellings from the source notes are retained in aliases where useful.
- Every note name is unique, so a `[[link]]` always points at one note. Quests that are also investigations live in `Quests/`, with their clues under **Clues & findings**.

chunks.heading: Metadata fields
chunks.text:
These power the tables in [[Dataview Queries]] and the live sections of the [[Campaign Dashboard]].

| Field | Used on | Values |
|---|---|---|
| `type` | every note | `pc`, `npc`, `location`, `faction`, `quest`, `mystery`, `item`, `lore`, `session` |
| `party_member` | party characters | `true` |
| `status` | quests & mysteries | `active`, `unresolved`, `upcoming`, `partially resolved`, `resolved`, `completed` |
| `first_seen` | anything linked from a session | the first session that links it |
| `location_type` / `item_type` | places / items | e.g. `inn`, `temple`, `weapon` |
| `session`, `d

chunks.heading: Metadata fields
chunks.text:
| e.g. `inn`, `temple`, `weapon` |
| `session`, `date` | sessions | number, `YYYY-MM-DD` |
| `previous_session`, `next_session` | sessions | links |
| `party`, `npcs`, `locations`, `factions`, `quests`, `items` | sessions | links to everything the session mentions |

Appearance counts and "last seen" aren't stored. Dataview works them out from which sessions link to a note, so **linking names in a new session note is all it takes** to keep those tables current.

chunks.heading: Adding a new session
chunks.text:
Step-by-step instructions, written for non-technical users, are in `scripts/README.md`. In short:
1. Paste the session into a new note in `Sessions/`, with the session number and date on the first lines.
2. Link people, places, factions, quests and items with `[[ ]]`.
3. Double-click **Update Vault (Mac).command** or **Update Vault (Windows).bat** in the `scripts` folder, or run `python3 scripts/update_all.py`. This sets up the new note, refreshes every note's metadata and **Session history** box, and rebuilds `dashboard/Icemoor Dashboard.html`.

chunks.heading: Dataview Queries
chunks.text:
Live tables built from the vault. They need the **Dataview** plugin (bundled in `.obsidian/plugins/dataview`; turn it on under *Settings → Community plugins* if Obsidian asks).

"Sessions" and "Last seen" are calculated from which session notes link to a page, so they update automatically when you add a new session and link names in it.

chunks.heading: Open quests & mysteries
chunks.text:
```dataview
TABLE WITHOUT ID
  file.link AS "Thread",
  status AS "Status",
  first_seen AS "Introduced",
  reverse(sort(filter(file.inlinks, (l) => startswith(meta(l).path, "Sessions/"))))[0] AS "Last touched"
FROM "Quests" OR "Clues & Mysteries"
WHERE status != "completed" AND status != "resolved"
SORT status ASC, file.name ASC
```

chunks.heading: Closed quests
chunks.text:
```dataview
TABLE WITHOUT ID file.link AS "Quest", status AS "Status", first_seen AS "Introduced"
FROM "Quests"
WHERE status = "completed" OR status = "resolved"
SORT file.name ASC
```

chunks.heading: The party
chunks.text:
```dataview
TABLE WITHOUT ID
  file.link AS "Character",
  type AS "Type",
  first_seen AS "First seen",
  length(filter(file.inlinks, (l) => startswith(meta(l).path, "Sessions/"))) AS "Sessions"
FROM "People"
WHERE party_member
SORT type DESC, file.name ASC
```

chunks.heading: Recently seen NPCs
chunks.text:
NPCs linked in the most recent sessions.

```dataview
TABLE WITHOUT ID
  file.link AS "NPC",
  reverse(sort(filter(file.inlinks, (l) => startswith(meta(l).path, "Sessions/"))))[0] AS "Last seen",
  length(filter(file.inlinks, (l) => startswith(meta(l).path, "Sessions/"))) AS "Sessions"
FROM "People"
WHERE type = "npc" AND length(filter(file.inlinks, (l) => startswith(meta(l).path, "Sessions/"))) > 0
SORT reverse(sort(filter(file.inlinks, (l) => startswith(meta(l).path, "Sessions/"))))[0] DESC
LIMIT 20
```

chunks.heading: Most recurring NPCs
chunks.text:
```dataview
TABLE WITHOUT ID
  file.link AS "NPC",
  length(filter(file.inlinks, (l) => startswith(meta(l).path, "Sessions/"))) AS "Sessions",
  first_seen AS "First seen"
FROM "People"
WHERE type = "npc"
SORT length(filter(file.inlinks, (l) => startswith(meta(l).path, "Sessions/"))) DESC
LIMIT 20
```

chunks.heading: NPCs never linked from a session
chunks.text:
Usually means a name in a session isn't linked yet, or the note came from the backstory.

```dataview
LIST
FROM "People"
WHERE type = "npc" AND length(filter(file.inlinks, (l) => startswith(meta(l).path, "Sessions/"))) = 0
SORT file.name ASC
```

chunks.heading: Session log
chunks.text:
```dataview
TABLE WITHOUT ID
  file.link AS "Session",
  date AS "Date",
  locations AS "Where",
  length(npcs) AS "NPCs",
  quests AS "Threads"
FROM "Sessions"
SORT session DESC
```

chunks.heading: Everywhere a person or place appears
chunks.text:
Change the name on the `WHERE` line to look anyone up.

```dataview
TABLE WITHOUT ID file.link AS "Session", date AS "Date"
FROM "Sessions"
WHERE contains(file.outlinks, [[Riffle]])
SORT session ASC
```
